result.summary: The page is generally usable, but the promotional banner has very low-contrast washed-out text, and some horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The promo banner text (“3 free deliveries for you” and code details) is very faint white on a pale mint background and is hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or use darker text colors so the promotional copy meets contrast guidelines.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and fastest-near-you card are visibly cut off at the screen edge, making content feel cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer edge padding, fade indicators, or snapping so partially visible carousel items look intentional rather than clipped.

issues.description: The restaurant name “Trattoria Piccol…” is truncated in the Fastest near you carousel.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles, reduce font size, or widen cards so restaurant names remain readable.
